Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 73, English)
The Science of Negativity , Guru Parampara Hierar chy , and Dimension-Climbing Conflict

Sour ce: a live Ashaeiynn session opening with an extended, genuinely negotiated discussion of havan/aura-checking/Thir d Eye scheduling, followed by an announcement of upcoming app featur es (a continuous-havan-access portal) and a goal of training 100 capable practitioners, then a long teaching on the "science" behind negativity , pitru influence, and astral attacks — covering guru parampara hierar chy , why unauthorized mantra practice backfir es, dimension-climbing conflict among fellow sadhaks, and a live aura-check exchange — closing with the thr ee elements (Agni tattva, V ishnu tattva/Guru, Shiv tattva) needed to build "sanskriti" within "prakriti." This session contains extensive live back-and-forth thr oughout (scheduling negotiation, technical audio tr oubleshooting, a live aura-check exchange), so it is pr ocessed as a full 3-part document.
1. Opening and Audio Troubleshooting
The session opens with the usual greetings, followed by a brief live back-and-forth about Bhaiya's microphone volume and an echo issue, resolved within the first couple of minutes.
2. Sequence Announcement: Aura Checking, Then Suryavanshi/Chandravanshi
Bhaiya states that once the current round of aura checking is complete (today or over the next day), the Suryavanshi and Chandravanshi teaching series will resume, in that order .
3. Third Eye Session Scheduling — A Live Negotiation

Bhaiya announces a new , separate Third Eye session starting the next day and opens the floor to discuss timing, since many members had asked for an evening slot. What follows is an extended live negotiation among several practitioners over specific time windows (6:00, 7:00–8:00, 8:00–8:30, 8:30, early morning 7:00–8:00), each raised and discussed for practicality (havan timing, work schedules, time-zone dif ferences for members abroad).
4. Why Bhaiya's Own Havan Timing Sometimes Slips

Per this teaching, Bhaiya candidly explains that although a stated havan time (e.g., 8:30 AM) is intended sincerely , he sometimes arrives closer to 9:00–9:15 due to genuine constraints — ongoing sadhnas, household responsibilities toward his own parents ("guru ki seva" extends to caring for elders), and, in winter , the cold genuinely slowing people down. He states he would rather be transparent about realistic timing than give false assurances that create repeated disappointment for waiting members.
5. Regional and Occupational Timing Conflicts

Per this teaching, no single time slot suits everyone — winter mornings are dif ficult in colder regions (though not in warmer ones like Gujarat), of fice-goers in Delhi/Gurugram/Noida need to leave for work by a certain hour , and overseas (e.g., UK-based) members must set alarms according to a very dif ferent time zone. Bhaiya acknowledges these are all genuine, not excuses.
6. Bhaiya's Reassurance: Partial Participation Is Valid

Per this teaching, if a practitioner cannot be physically present for a havan's exact timing, taking the sankalp (intention) at that time and continuing jaap while commuting or working still carries genuine benefit ("rambaan ka kaarya karega") — full, direct participation is ideal, but not the only valid form of participation.
7. Delegation Plan: Training Others to Lead Havan

In response to a member's suggestion, Bhaiya agrees it would help to train additional capable people to independently lead havan sessions (citing earlier examples of other practitioners who had taken up this role at dif ferent times), so the responsibility isn't concentrated on one person alone.
8. Upcoming App Featur e: A Continuous-Havan-Access Portal

Per this teaching, a new app update is coming with many new features, including a planned portal that would allow continuous, roundthe-clock havan access — intended especially for practitioners with severe negativity , who could use this direct access to substantially resolve issues within a much shorter window (a few days) rather than the typical 1 1–30 days a standard negativity-clearing havan can take.
9. The Goal of Training 100 Capable Practitioners

Per this teaching, Bhaiya reaf firms a standing commitment from his own guru — to personally train 100 people capable of handling every kind of elemental/ener getic work — and states this process (havan-leading, puja, and broader capability-building) is already underway and expected to substantially mature within roughly five to six months.
10. Why Ashaeiynn Deliberately Limits Public Scale

Per this teaching, Bhaiya explains that the community intentionally avoids lar ge-scale public exposure (e.g., open YouT ube live sessions) because rapid, uncontrolled growth in numbers would come at the cost of quality and personal attention — he would rather serve a more limited group of people well than dilute the depth of guidance available to each person.
1 1. The Combined "V ishnu Yog"/"Antim Yog" of Vedic Practice

Per this teaching, the combination of havan, puja, anushthan, mantra recitation, guru paddhati (method), and finally Ram Naam together forms what is called "V ishnu yog" or "antim yog" — described as an unusually powerful alignment that builds progressively over time for those who follow this traditional path consistently .
12. Why "Y ou Don't Know the Science" Is the Real Vulnerability

Per this teaching, fear of ghosts/spirits/negativity stems specifically from not understanding the underlying mechanics ("science") of how these entities operate — negativity is described as being exactly as intelligent as the person it is af fecting, since it originated from a human being, not as an inherently mindless or random force.
13. Spirits/Entities Know Names Because They Learn Them, Not Innately

Per this teaching, when a spirit calls someone by name, this is not proof of some special divine-level omniscience — it simply learned the name by hearing it spoken nearby (e.g., overhearing someone call "Gupta ji"), the same way a person could train anyone to repeat a phrase through simple repetition ("copycat" psychology , illustrated with a formula-repetition example).
14. What Genuinely Distinguishes Divine Power From Copycat Entities

Per this teaching, only genuine divine ener gy (as opposed to copycat/mimicking lower entities) inherently knows a person's name in advance, without having to learn it — this distinction requires guru paddhati, guru tattva, and one's own kul (ancestral lineage) shakti to properly access and verify .
15. Pr eparation Requir ed Befor e Astral Experimentation

Per this teaching, before any genuine astral-world experimentation, a practitioner needs specifically: guru paddhati (the guru's own method), guru tattva (the guru's underlying ener getic principle), and kul ki shakti (the strength of one's own ancestral lineage) — without these, a practitioner remains "unbeatable" only in a false sense, vulnerable rather than protected.
16. Why Unauthorized Mantra Practice Backfir es

Per this teaching, starting any mantra practice (even something as apparently simple as an aarti) without going through the mantra's own established guru lineage and without proper permission means the practice will never fully activate ("siddha") no matter how many decades it is repeated — every established mantra has its own rishi and lineage of transmission, and skipping that authorization is described as spiritually equivalent to unlicensed use of someone else's established name or trademark, inviting direct correction from that lineage.
17. What Happens the Moment a Mantra's Energy First Activates

Per this teaching, when a practitioner's chosen mantra (e.g., Gayatri mantra) begins to genuinely build ener gy in the body , the first thing that responds is the surrounding negativity or the practitioner's own pitru ener gy , if any is present; if neither is present, the mantra's ener gy rises further and reaches out to the cosmos itself (illustrated by the bij mantra "Om Bhur Bhuvah" as a literal cosmic connection signal), at which point the relevant lok (plane/realm) becomes aware a connection request has been made.
18. Why the First "Attack" After Cosmic Connection Is an Energy Exchange, Not Malice

Per this teaching, once a genuine cosmic connection is made without proper guru-lineage permission, the very first response ("the first arrow") comes specifically because the practitioner is ef fectively requesting ener gy from that lok without having anything to of fer in exchange — described not as random hostility but as an ener gy-exchange mechanism responding to an unauthorized, one-sided request.
19. Why Guru Parampara Pr events This Backfir e

Per this teaching, within a proper guru lineage, a practitioner is never drawing ener gy alone — thousands of sants collectively generate and channel ener gy upward together , and it returns properly channeled; a lone, unauthorized practitioner instead ends up drawing on their own body's chakras and pran (vital ener gy) directly , which is unsustainable and, without an external source, exposes them to surrounding entities eager to attach and draw from that self-generated ener gy instead.
20. Reassurance Woven Into the Danger: The Guru's Response

Per this teaching, when a practitioner in this vulnerable, self-generating state genuinely calls out (e.g., to Hanuman ji Maharaj), the response comes — described poetically as "why fear when I am here" — and the connection completes properly from that point forward, though this initial vulnerable period genuinely does draw on the practitioner's own bodily ener gy until it does.
21. The Real Work Begins After Proper Connection: Dimension Climbing

Per this teaching, once a practitioner is properly connected through guru parampara, the true progression (dimension climbing) begins — and this stage explicitly requires deep respect toward sants, since although higher entities like Hanuman ji Maharaj himself require no personal reverence for their own sake, the sants and mahatmas who make up the working structure of that lineage do require respect and acknowledgment.
22. Why Dimension-Climbing Pr oduces "Office Politics"-Style Attacks

Per this teaching, as a practitioner's own bhakti and dimension-level rises, comparison and low-level conflict naturally arise among fellow practitioners occupying similar levels — compared explicitly to coworkers at the same rank in a company who may undermine one another (through gossip, hindrance, subtle competition) but cannot seriously harm each other , since they ultimately belong to the same "company" (the same guru lineage) and would face consequences for doing so.
23. Why People Often Misattribute Negativity to Family Members

Per this teaching, when practitioners experience repeated symptoms attributed to a relative's tantra or ill will (e.g., "meri chachi ne karaya hai"), roughly three-quarters or more of such attributions are not genuine deliberate acts by that person — Bhaiya cautions against confirming such suspicions casually , since doing so can cause serious, undeserved emotional harm to accused family members who are often themselves innocent and struggling.
24. The Real Sour ce of Repeated "Kriya" Symptoms: Peer Competition, Not Family Malice

Per this teaching, repeated symptoms in a serious, committed practitioner (e.g., someone doing four hours of daily jaap) are far more often the result of dimension-level peer competition among fellow sadhaks at a similar spiritual rank — described as an inevitable, ongoing "war condition" for a genuinely advancing bhakt — rather than being caused by named family members, who are frequently blamed unfairly .
25. Why Mor e Attacks Ultimately Mean Mor e Growth

Per this teaching, the more a genuinely advancing practitioner is tar geted by this kind of dimension-level competitive resistance, the more their sookshma sharir (subtle body) is forced to fight and, in doing so, grow — described as an unavoidable, continuous process ("we fight every day , and gradually we grow") rather than a one-time or optional trial.
26. Support Is Available Mid-Fight

Per this teaching, when this kind of attack becomes overwhelming, a practitioner can and should call on higher supporting powers (their guru/ista devta) for relief — this is described as a normal, expected part of the process, not a sign of failure, and genuinely brings relief when invoked sincerely .
27. Why Isolation Incr eases Vulnerability

Per this teaching, when people distance themselves from each other's supportive presence (aabhamandal), it becomes easier for surrounding negative ener gies to gain influence over them — closeness and connection between people is described as a genuine protective factor against exactly this kind of intrusion, since isolated individuals lack that mutual reinforcing presence.
28. A Live Aura-Check Example (Identity Withheld Per Ashaeiynn Policy)

A practitioner requested guidance ahead of being unavailable for the next two days due to a family wedding. Per this teaching's live reading (kept general here, consistent with Ashaeiynn's stated policy of not publicly naming any practitioner while negativity is still present), some tantra-related influence and pitru connection were noted in her household, alongside a genuine divine presence not yet fully manifested into full protective strength; she was advised that continued jaap would resolve this over time and that her drishti (spiritual sight) would open in due course.
29. The Abhishek Sharma Example: How Deceptive "Bicholi" (Intermediary) Entities Operate

Per this teaching, Bhaiya describes a recent aura-check case (practitioner named, as the account centers on the entity's deceptive technique rather than any personal failing of his) involving a long-time, extremely dedicated practitioner who had been told by others

that a major tantra-based obstruction was preventing his household stability , despite his own extensive personal jaap. Per this teaching, Bhaiya found instead that a deceptive intermediary ("bicholi") entity — capable of convincingly misleading even other readers because its own accumulated ener gy exceeded the practitioner's — had been the true source of the confusion, and it was identified and addressed directly; this is presented as a caution against trusting readings uncritically , since such intermediary entities specifically exploit confusion between two parties for their own benefit.
30. The Three Elements Needed to Build "Sanskriti" Within "Prakriti"

Per this teaching's closing reflection, building genuine spiritual culture/order within raw nature requires three elements together: Agni tattva (the element of fire/sacrifice), Vishnu tattva (represented through the guru), and Shiv tattva — and practitioners are ur ged to hold onto their own name, jaap, and guru through all of the mechanics described in this session.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

No single havan/session time suits every member; Bhaiya favors transparent, realistic scheduling over promises he may not consistently keep, and encourages taking sankalp and continuing jaap even when full physical attendance isn't possible. A future app portal is planned for continuous, round-the-clock havan access, intended especially to substantially shorten resolution time for practitioners with severe negativity . Ashaeiynn intentionally limits public scale to protect the depth and quality of individual guidance, rather than pursuing rapid, uncontrolled growth. Havan + puja + anushthan + mantra + guru paddhati + Ram Naam together form what this teaching calls "V ishnu yog"/"antim yog," a cumulative alignment built over consistent practice. Negativity is not inherently more intelligent or powerful than the person it af fects — fear of it comes specifically from not understanding its actual mechanics, not from any real overwhelming force. A spirit calling someone by name is not proof of special power — it typically learned the name by simply overhearing it, the same way anyone can be trained through repetition. Any mantra practice started without its proper guru lineage and permission will never fully activate, no matter how long it is repeated — every established mantra has its own rishi and transmission lineage that must be respected. When a mantra's ener gy first begins to build, it draws a response first from nearby negativity/pitru ener gy , then reaches the cosmos itself if none is present — an unauthorized, un-channeled cosmic request typically draws an initial corrective response as an ener gy-exchange mechanism, not as malice. Guru parampara protects against this because ener gy is drawn collectively (thousands of sants together) rather than by one person alone; genuine calls for help within this structure are answered. As dimension-level and bhakti rise, "of fice politics"-style low-level conflict naturally arises among fellow practitioners at similar levels — this cannot seriously harm a committed practitioner and is a normal, if uncomfortable, part of genuine spiritual growth. Most attributions of ongoing symptoms to a specific family member's ill will are not accurate and can cause serious, undeserved harm if voiced casually; repeated symptoms in a serious practitioner are far more often peer -level spiritual competition than family malice. More resistance faced by a genuinely advancing practitioner corresponds to more growth in their subtle body over time; support can and should be invoked when this becomes overwhelming. Isolation from other people's supportive presence increases vulnerability to negative influence; genuine closeness between people is a real protective factor . Deceptive intermediary ("bicholi") entities can convincingly mislead even experienced readers by exploiting confusion between two parties — readings should not be trusted uncritically . Building genuine spiritual order requires three elements together: Agni tattva, Vishnu tattva (through the guru), and Shiv tattva.
